summary: This bill requires the Department of Homeland Security to submit recurring reports every three years on the transition of jurisdictions that are no longer eligible for Urban Area Security Initiative funding.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends existing law to require recurring reports on jurisdictions no longer eligible for Urban Area Security Initiative funding. While it doesn't directly allocate or cut funding, the reporting requirement implies an administrative cost and oversight related to federal security spending, making it tangentially related to government spending.

The bill amends the James M. Inhofe National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2023 and concerns the Urban Area Security Initiative, which is a Department of Homeland Security program. This directly relates to national security and defense, specifically regarding how federal funds are managed for urban security.
